title: Input Tax Credit (ITC) Rules under GST
source: CBIC, Ministry of Finance, Government of India
content: Input Tax Credit (ITC) allows registered GST taxpayers to reduce the tax paid on business inputs (purchases of raw materials, capital goods, and business services) from the tax payable on output supplies (sales). Conditions to claim ITC include: 1. Taxpayer must possess a valid tax invoice or debit note issued by a registered supplier. 2. Goods or services must have been received. 3. The supplier must have remitted the GST to the government and filed GSTR-1/GSTR-3B so it reflects in GSTR-2B. Blocked credits under Section 17(5) cannot be claimed for ITC, such as motor vehicles for personal transport, food & beverages, outdoor catering, membership of clubs, and personal consumption expenses.
